name: agentic-website-studio
description: Evidence-first foundation for rights-aware website reference research.

scripts.ensure-local-dirs: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const dir of ['.tmp','.npm-cache']) fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true})"
scripts.studio:build: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp tsc -p tsconfig.studio.json
scripts.studio: npm run studio:build --silent && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp npm_config_cache=.npm-cache node .tmp/studio-dist/src/cli.js
scripts.test: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp npm_config_cache=.npm-cache vitest run --maxWorkers=1
scripts.wayfinder:build: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp vite build --config vite.wayfinder.config.ts
scripts.wayfinder:preview: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp vite preview --config vite.wayfinder.config.ts
scripts.wayfinder:test: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp vitest run tests/wayfinder-state.test.ts tests/wayfinder-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.wayfinder:e2e: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp playwright test --config playwright.wayfinder.config.ts
scripts.wayfinder:artifacts: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp node --experimental-strip-types src/m43r-artifacts.ts
scripts.wayfinder:artifact-test: cross-env TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp vitest run tests/m42-artifacts.test.ts tests/m42r-artifacts.test.ts tests/m43-artifacts.test.ts tests/m43r-artifacts.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.wayfinder:qa: npm run wayfinder:build && npm run wayfinder:test && npm run wayfinder:e2e && npm run wayfinder:artifacts && npm run wayfinder:artifact-test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run wayfinder:build
